written: 2026-11-10, before any aperiodic value of any subject was computed
hypotheses_from: Wang Z et al. (2023) GeroScience 46:751-768, doi:10.1007/s11357-023-01041-8 (same ds004504 cohort)
subjects: 36 AD vs 23 FTD; healthy controls only in the positive controls (S3)
data: first 75 join-free 4 s epochs per subject (300 s), common average reference
spectrum: Welch per epoch (Hamming 250 samples, overlap 125, nfft 1024), mean over the epochs
fit_filter: a channel's exponent and offset enter the subject's mean only if R^2 >= 0.95; a subject with no such channel is left out of H1/H2 and reported

primary.H1: mean aperiodic exponent over channels is higher in AD than in FTD
primary.H2: mean aperiodic offset over channels is higher in AD than in FTD
primary.H3: mean over the 19 channels of log10(theta 4-8 Hz / alpha 8-12 Hz absolute power) is higher in AD than in FTD. Not blind: theta and alpha band power were already compared by diagnosis in results/univariate.csv

test: AUC = P(AD score > FTD score), the score used as is (nothing fitted); one-sided permutation p from 10000 shuffles of the 59 diagnoses; Holm over H1-H3; supported if Holm p < 0.05; 95 % CI from 2000 stratified subject bootstraps
secondary: S1: likelihood-ratio test for each score added to an unpenalised logistic model of MMSE + age + sex
S2: L2 logistic regression (C = 0.1, balanced) on H1-H3 together, 20 x 5-fold CV over subjects, with the folds of ADvsFTD_ds004504.ipynb, against 500 label shuffles
S3: positive controls AD vs HC (expected higher in AD) and FTD vs HC (Wang et al.: no difference)
S4: sensitivity without the R^2 filter, and each channel separately (descriptive)
S5: H1-H2 again with 2 s Hann windows (50 % overlap), which recover a known exponent exactly
amendment: 2026-11-10, still before any subject's EEG was read: the Cell 2 self-test showed that Wang et al.'s 0.5 s window overestimates steep exponents (1/f^1.5 -> 1.73, 1/f^2 -> 2.48), because power below 2 Hz leaks into the fit range; S5 was added. H1-H3 keep Wang et al.'s settings, since they are the claim under test
decision: the result is reported whatever it is
